<tcoratger> Hi everyone,

For your information, we're currently working on a specification for the XMSS signature scheme. In this context, we've started by adding much more extensive documentation for the main trait of the Rust implementation here: https://github.com/b-wagn/hash-sig/pull/71

We hope this will clarify your use of this crypto library with useful information on how to use this trait 🙂
